references.use: Aircraft-specific electrical and hydraulic architecture; the fictional fleet's voltages, loads, generator allowances and pump flow ratings are explicit concept estimates, not values taken from this handbook
Weight and balance accounting; unusable fuel retained in empty mass
2% expansion space relative to fill capacity; unusable quantity requires adverse-condition feed tests, so the 3% allowance is explicitly estimated
Jet fuel density 775–840 kg/m3 at 15 C; nominal 800 selected

limitations: Electrical/hydraulic load and capacity allowances are aircraft-specific estimates. Generator loads, hydraulic flow transients and system-failure power losses are not yet coupled to the flight integrator.
No structural or manufacturer mass data for these fictional aircraft. Existing empty-mass totals are retained and decomposed, rather than double-counting installed structure.
A three percent uniform volume-displacement allowance and three percent trapped-fuel allowance are estimates, not measured feed-test results.
Fuel settles against horizontal body-Y levels; slosh, inverted operation, fuel transfer transients and failures are outside this model.
